purpose: Provider public-terms triage for HOST-001..003. This artifact records official public-source restrictions and missing evidence only. It is not a provider contract, order form, redistribution license, account entitlement, legal approval, or executable provider-rights bundle and must never promote hosted provider eligibility.
runtimePromotionRule: Only a separately reviewed provider-specific agreement/license/order-form evidence package may be transformed into the SHA-256-pinned provider-rights-bundle-v19.0.0 executable contract. Public web terms and working API credentials are never sufficient.

evidence.title: FRED Services Terms of Use
evidence.finding: Current FRED terms require compliance with series-owner restrictions, prohibit commercial redistribution of third-party proprietary content without permission, prohibit AI/ML use, and restrict storing/caching/archiving FRED content through the API.

evidence.title: FRED API Terms of Use
evidence.finding: FRED API access does not override third-party copyrights or series restrictions; permission from data owners can be required for non-personal use.

evidence.title: SEC - Accessing EDGAR Data
evidence.finding: SEC states EDGAR filing information can be accessed and downloaded for free while automated access is governed by fair-access controls including a current 10-requests-per-second maximum.

evidence.title: SEC Developer Resources
evidence.finding: SEC reiterates efficient scripted access and fair-access controls. Public filing availability is preserved as direct SEC/EDGAR authority but is not treated as a blanket approval for every hosted redistribution, embedded third-party-content or AI use case.
